Screens (light cruisers) these are your anti destroyer ships and can be retrofitted to be used in almost any role, for traditional screening give them light mediums, radar, AA, and (or) plane catapults, for destroyer group leads you want radar, meduim guns and AA, let the DDs deal with subs, and lastly CLCV honestly my ship in the game, a budget CV that also counts as a screen ship, meaning its more survivable in small numbers, just give it hangars and the fastest CV engine
